summary: Switch WebSocket senders to Fractal protocols after fleet-wide receiver adoption

replay.detail: No persisted claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or HTTP API version changes. Generated client WebSocket constants and requests use fractal.client.* and fractal.cap.*.

rules.detail: Registry strings, hash separators, signed st3.v1 envelopes, st3-replication-v1 and st3-member-v1 domains and pinned compatibility fixtures remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: WebSocket senders offer one Fractal surface and, when required, one Fractal capability. Old-only clients remain accepted by #3430 receivers. New senders require those accepting receivers; no automatic old-name retry is introduced. Dual offers are deliberately not used because #3430 rejects them.

downtime.detail: No coordinated downtime is needed when the receiver-first rollout prerequisite is respected.

manual.detail: Do not land or deploy this sender cutover until every receiving fleet host is recorded on #3430 or later. HTTP headers and API/error/visualization version writers remain unchanged. The arn:lmig:smalltalk:2026-10-16-wire-fractal-accept-both bridge contracts on 2026-11-01 per #3032 R5.

recovery.detail: Restore old-only senders before rolling any receiver back below alias support. No persistent state rewrite or re-pairing is needed.
